bio: Matthew Martin Little (born November 24, 1984) is an American attorney and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for Minnesota's 2nd congressional district. A member of the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL), Little represented District 58 in the Minnesota Senate from 2017 to 2021.
